metadata.description: The nested case. dist/packages/microsoft is ONE npm package whose entry points (the root and microsoft-nestjs) compile into this directory and are named by this package's own dist `exports`. So this target is the sole deliverable and the sole owner of the directory; the children deliberately have no `build` of their own. The children are dependsOn EDGES (one Nx process, one graph), and the finalize stays this target's own command so it runs after every entry point is built.

`^build`, NOT the `^build-base` @nx/rollup/plugin infers. @nx/js remaps @dereekb/* imports to the dist DIRECTORY, so TypeScript reads that directory's package.json `exports` to resolve them -- and rollup writes `.` as {import, types} until that dependency's own `build` reorders it. `^build-base` would compile this package against un-finalized dependencies.
